summary: Apply professional codes to software quality, conflicts, and escalation. Explore this five-day IT ethics training course.
lede: IT ethics helps technology practitioners weigh professional duties against delivery pressure and document defensible decisions. For software engineers, IT operations analysts and technology team leads, the course practises mapping duties to stakeholders, assessing software quality concerns, and recording conflicts. Participants also examine AI-assisted code provenance and prepare escalation notes using professional codes and software quality criteria.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits professionals whose IT decisions affect software quality, technical advice, delivery commitments, or the way concerns reach responsible decision-makers.
modules: ACM and IEEE Professional Ethics Codes
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with routine IT work, such as software delivery, IT operations, systems analysis, or technical support. No coding or programming is required.
topics: Legal risk for AI, data and digital services
